seed.meaning: API seed; A* is deterministic and draws no random samples.

runs.title: D* Lite repairs after an obstacle appears
runs.summary: One persistent D* Lite session updates four directed edge costs and repairs its route.

seed.meaning: Not applicable; deterministic graph search uses no random samples.

input.environment: Defined 24 x 16 four-connected demonstration grid; not an external benchmark.
input.source: Defined demonstration graph, not a benchmark map.
input.movement: Four cardinal neighbors; unit edge cost.

result.validity_method: Each cell and cardinal edge checked against the updated graph; the inserted cell is absent and path cost is recomputed.

runs.title: RRT* in BARN world_236 geometry
runs.summary: A native RRT* run on a point-robot XY query derived from BARN world_236.

seed.meaning: NumPy default_rng seed passed through the package API.

source.geometry_extraction: world/model/link/collision cylinder poses composed in XY; planes ignored; each cylinder represented by its exact center and radius

input.robot_model: point robot in XY; no Jackal footprint or kinematic constraints

query.derivation: Farthest pair sampled from the largest component of a 64x64 point-robot grid, using the collision-checked undirected adjacency and NumPy default_rng(seed).

input.movement: Euclidean straight-line local connections; collision checking at 0.01 m.

result.validity_method: All path states and complete line segments checked analytically against all 254 original source circles; path length recomputed in Euclidean XY.

phases.label: Sampling and rewiring
phases.validity_method: All path states and complete line segments checked analytically against all original source circles; path length recomputed in Euclidean XY.
